entities.title: Event card exposed
entities.definition: A unique event card became eligible and actually visible on a registered product surface for the accepted exposure threshold.
unresolved_conflicts: Unified production exposure collection is not yet complete across all page families.

entities.title: Event card opened
entities.definition: The user activated a registered card open target and navigation resolved to the matching canonical event identity.

confidence.basis: Analytics and Search card identity contracts.

unresolved_conflicts: Accepted Search health proves one bounded route; global ingestion is broader.

entities.title: Engaged event detail
entities.definition: The user reached the accepted meaningful-reading threshold on an event detail page; this is event-value evidence but not proof of attendance or satisfaction.
unresolved_conflicts: Meaningful-reading threshold and production coverage require implementation receipts.

entities.title: Event saved
entities.definition: An idempotent save command reached its authoritative accepted state for one logical event identity.
unresolved_conflicts: Authoritative store and identity reconciliation differ by current state mode.

entities.title: Event removed from saved
entities.definition: A confirmed idempotent remove command cleared the accepted saved state for one logical event identity.

entities.title: Calendar action completed
entities.definition: The capability-specific calendar success condition was reached for the exact selected occurrence; download or navigation alone is not silently upgraded when terminal proof is unavailable.

confidence.basis: Analytics strong-action taxonomy and native calendar boundary.

unresolved_conflicts: Browser-generated ICS and real calendar import have different evidence strength.

entities.title: Event shared or copied
entities.definition: The accepted native-share or clipboard success condition occurred for the exact canonical event target; cancellation or denial is excluded.
unresolved_conflicts: Native share success semantics and downstream open are platform-specific.

entities.title: Ticket or registration destination opened
entities.definition: The user opened the accepted exact ticket or registration destination for the current event; it is an intent action, not proof of purchase or registration.

confidence.basis: Analytics explicitly distinguishes click from terminal submission.

unresolved_conflicts: No trusted callback exists for every external provider.

entities.title: Route or transport destination opened
entities.definition: The user activated an eligible named-location or transport destination for the current event and selected occurrence.

confidence.basis: Analytics action taxonomy and route/transport acceptance.

unresolved_conflicts: Navigation attempt does not prove arrival or transport use.

entities.title: Search submitted
entities.definition: An eligible user submitted one bounded Search intent, represented without raw query text in the general analytics stream.
unresolved_conflicts: General analytics retention and aggregation remain broader than Search health receipts.

entities.title: Exact Search results rendered
entities.definition: A bounded exact Search result set was rendered with card identities matching the backend response and current target.
unresolved_conflicts: Rendered results are output evidence, not a satisfaction outcome.

entities.title: Search reached zero exact results
entities.definition: Search completed with an explicit exact zero-result terminal state before feedback and separately labeled alternatives.
unresolved_conflicts: A zero result may be correct when eligible supply is absent.

entities.title: Search match feedback submitted
entities.definition: At the accepted terminal boundary the user submitted `matched` or `missed` for the Search attempt.
unresolved_conflicts: Feedback is subjective task evidence and must be analyzed with result/supply context.

entities.title: Personal feed opened
entities.definition: The user opened `/dlya-menya/` with an explicit static, cold-start, contextual or personalized presentation mode and compatible revision metadata.
unresolved_conflicts: Unified production event collection and exact mode coverage are incomplete.

entities.title: Event hidden as not interesting
entities.definition: An explicit idempotent hide/not-interested command reached its authoritative accepted state for the exact event identity.
unresolved_conflicts: Action-map diagnostics cannot substitute for this explicit event.

entities.title: Hidden event restored
entities.definition: An explicit undo/restore command returned the exact event to the accepted visible state without duplicate signal or card identity.

entities.title: Authentication started
entities.definition: The user began one accepted Yandex/email/OTP authentication flow for a capability that requires identity.
unresolved_conflicts: Identity surface ownership differs across routes.

entities.title: Authentication completed
entities.definition: The selected authentication method reached full accepted session completion and the intended capability can safely resume.

confidence.basis: Analytics and Search health session contract.

unresolved_conflicts: Search health test sessions do not prove every public identity edge case.

entities.title: Feedback submitted
entities.definition: One purpose-specific feedback command was accepted or durably queued with a protected opaque feedback identity and typed delivery state.
unresolved_conflicts: Focus-group and general production feedback modes have different maturity.

entities.title: Static release candidate verified
entities.definition: An immutable candidate completed its exact source/snapshot/manifest checks and produced a terminal verification receipt without implying root promotion.
unresolved_conflicts: Candidate verification does not close public-root or critical-data gates.

entities.title: Production incident opened
entities.definition: A bounded episode with material user or operator impact was formally opened with severity, affected capability/context and initial evidence.

entities.title: Production incident closed
entities.definition: Containment, authoritative repair, reviewed deployment, production verification and prevention evidence satisfied the incident closure gate.

confidence.basis: Incident management and latest closed incident.

unresolved_conflicts: Incident closure does not prove global capability health or absence of recurrence.

entities.title: Can eligible users find an event-value result within 30 unique cards?
entities.definition: For sessions where suitable eligible supply exists, what share reaches engaged detail or an accepted intent action before more than 30 unique card exposures, by route, device, mode and new/returning cohort?

measurement_contract.denominator: eligible sessions with at least one owner-reviewed suitable event in current inventory
measurement_contract.numerator: sessions reaching event value within <=30 unique exposed cards

unresolved_conflicts: Suitable-event ground truth and complete exposure ingestion are not yet operational across all surfaces.

entities.title: Does event detail provide enough coherent information for a decision?
entities.definition: Among eligible detail viewers, how often do users reach key facts, report usefulness or complete an intent/continuation action, and where do missing/contradictory facts cause abandonment or issue feedback?

measurement_contract.denominator: eligible event-detail viewers

unresolved_conflicts: Behavioral proxies do not directly prove confidence; qualitative evidence remains necessary.

entities.title: Do event intent actions reach an honest usable outcome?
entities.definition: For each action kind, what share of eligible attempts reaches its authoritative success or accepted navigation outcome, remains pending, fails terminally or reports false success?

measurement_contract.denominator: eligible authoritative or external-handoff attempts by action kind

unresolved_conflicts: External providers do not all expose terminal callbacks.

entities.title: Does Search produce a usable exact result or an honest recovery path?
entities.definition: Among eligible Search submissions, what share renders exact cards, opens a result, reaches zero result honestly, recovers from typed failure or receives matched/missed feedback?

measurement_contract.denominator: eligible Search submissions

unresolved_conflicts: Accepted health covers service behavior; satisfaction-rate production aggregates are incomplete.

entities.title: What do users report at the exact Search result boundary?
entities.definition: Among Search attempts eligible for terminal feedback, what share submits matched/missed, how does it vary by result count and intent class, and which reviewed searches justify a separate static-page evaluation?

measurement_contract.denominator: Search attempts that reached the terminal feedback placement

unresolved_conflicts: Feedback does not automatically approve a public saved Search; separate review remains required.

entities.title: Can users recover unique current saved-event state?
entities.definition: Among users with saved state, what share opens Favorites successfully, sees each logical event once, resolves lifecycle/account state and continues/removes without duplicate or leakage?

measurement_contract.denominator: actors with at least one accepted saved-event identity

unresolved_conflicts: Unified local/account/multi-device receipts are incomplete.

entities.title: Are critical event facts coherent across all active surfaces?
entities.definition: For current event revisions, what share has matching identity, occurrence, lifecycle, venue, admission and canonical target across card, detail, JSON-LD, ICS, share and managed messages, and how many stale-publication incidents occur?

measurement_contract.denominator: eligible current event revisions and their active public artifacts

unresolved_conflicts: Recent incident is closed but proves continuing runtime risk.

entities.title: Do users return after reaching event value?
entities.definition: What are D1/D7/D30 return rates after first engaged detail, save, Search success, personal-feed value, artifact or PWA install compared with eligible baselines?

measurement_contract.denominator: new actors reaching the specified first-value event

unresolved_conflicts: Unified actor/session fact model and daily aggregates are incomplete.

entities.title: What share of active actors reaches event value?
entities.definition: Among active actors, what share reaches engaged detail or an accepted save/calendar/share/ticket/registration/route/transport action, with correct denominators and no double counting?

measurement_contract.denominator: unique active actors for the reporting day
measurement_contract.numerator: actors reaching at least one registered event-value fact

unresolved_conflicts: Unified production ingest and actor/day aggregates are incomplete.

entities.title: Is the current catalog trustworthy, diverse and sufficiently covered?
entities.definition: What share of current events has complete critical facts and media, no duplicate family, current lifecycle and useful geographic/theme/format coverage, and where supply gaps or source failures remain?

measurement_contract.denominator: eligible current/future catalog events and required source/projection groups

unresolved_conflicts: Critical data progression and owner-gold collection quality remain incomplete.

entities.title: Does the service remain healthy within reliability and cost budgets?
entities.definition: Are accepted routes, Search, queues, providers, storage, database, LLM, network and browser budgets within thresholds, with typed coverage and no hidden stale evidence?

confidence.basis: Analytics, Search health, release and incident contracts.

measurement_contract.denominator: accepted runtime cells and due operational windows

unresolved_conflicts: Search health is accepted; recent disk pressure and incomplete data progression prevent global healthy status.

entities.title: Are product decisions linked to sufficient reviewed evidence?
entities.definition: For accepted decisions, is there a traceable measurement question, immutable evidence, limitations, reviewed finding, owner decision and follow-up, and are unsupported outcomes clearly marked?

measurement_contract.denominator: accepted product decisions in scope

unresolved_conflicts: Many historical decisions predate this v1 linkage and need gradual backfill.

entities.title: Do curated contexts help users reach event value without fabricated membership?
entities.definition: For each collection/festival/exhibition/club context, do eligible viewers reach current member events and event value with acceptable freshness, supply, diversity and source-grounded membership?

measurement_contract.denominator: eligible curated-context viewers

unresolved_conflicts: Different curated families have different quality and deployment maturity.

entities.title: Does continuation help after event evaluation?
entities.definition: Among users reaching related/broader sections, what share sees eligible cards, opens or reaches value on another event, and where duplicates, sparse supply or mislabeled relation evidence occur?

measurement_contract.denominator: event-detail viewers who reached the continuation placement

unresolved_conflicts: No unified production continuation funnel yet exists.

entities.title: Does personalization improve bounded discovery while preserving diversity?
entities.definition: In a registered holdout, does compatible personalization improve cards-to-value and intent actions versus static fallback without increasing hide rate, narrowing diversity, harming performance or causing profile/revision failures?

measurement_contract.denominator: eligible actors in a registered randomized or holdout comparison

unresolved_conflicts: No accepted registered randomized result currently proves uplift.

entities.title: Do typed recovery paths let users continue safely?
entities.definition: For each failure class and context, what share retains core content, understands the state and completes the accepted retry/alternate/restore action without duplicate work or false success?

measurement_contract.denominator: eligible typed failure/recovery attempts

unresolved_conflicts: No single aggregate can substitute for route/capability-specific recovery evidence.

entities.title: Does product feedback reach durable triage and resolution?
entities.definition: Among eligible feedback attempts by purpose, what share is accepted/delivered, triaged, assigned, resolved, verified or reopened, and how long does each stage take?

measurement_contract.denominator: eligible feedback attempts by accepted purpose

unresolved_conflicts: Feedback modes and persistence owners differ.

entities.title: Is the exact static candidate ready for public root promotion?
entities.definition: For the exact repository/snapshot/build/manifest tuple, have production profile, catalog parity, critical data progression, stable identity, browser/native acceptance, publication safety and rollback gates all produced terminal evidence?

measurement_contract.denominator: one exact candidate tuple

unresolved_conflicts: Current result remains NO-GO for public root promotion.

entities.title: Did every required data producer run, observe upstream and reach the exact candidate?
entities.definition: For every due required producer, was upstream actually observed, did a fresh or checked no-change receipt exist, were partial failures/backlogs absent, and did the exact downstream export consume it?

measurement_contract.denominator: all due producer groups marked required by the exact production manifest

unresolved_conflicts: Three scheduled PASS days and required failure drills are not present.

entities.title: Are production incidents contained, repaired and prevented from recurring?
entities.definition: For material incidents, how quickly are harmful side effects stopped, authoritative state repaired, a reviewed fix deployed and verified, and does the same failure mode recur?

measurement_contract.denominator: material production incidents in scope

unresolved_conflicts: One closed incident cannot establish long-term recurrence rate.

entities.title: Are consent, minimization and retention boundaries working?
entities.definition: Do optional writes stop when consent is absent/withdrawn, do prohibited fields remain zero, do retention/deletion jobs complete, and do Product Atlas/evidence packages contain only reviewed allowed data?

measurement_contract.denominator: optional product-data operations and retention windows

unresolved_conflicts: Unified analytics runtime and deletion/export evidence are incomplete.

entities.title: Do UI and instrumentation preserve performance and layout stability?
entities.definition: Across representative route/archetype/state/device cells, are LCP/INP/CLS, overflow, skeleton-to-content geometry and interaction responsiveness within accepted thresholds without optional telemetry blocking navigation?

confidence.basis: Analytics, action-map and visual acceptance contracts.

measurement_contract.denominator: registered representative route/archetype/state/device cells

unresolved_conflicts: Unified production Web Vitals and skeleton evidence are incomplete.

entities.title: Can eligible users complete or safely recover authentication?
entities.definition: By method/device/route, what share of auth starts reaches full session completion, where does abandonment/failure occur, and can the intended capability resume without duplicate OTP or cross-account state?

confidence.basis: Analytics auth funnel and acceptance inventory.

measurement_contract.denominator: eligible authentication starts

unresolved_conflicts: Search health sessions are accepted but full public auth funnel aggregates are incomplete.

entities.title: Public static root release remains NO-GO
entities.definition: The checked static site has immutable candidate evidence but cannot be declared publicly released because root infrastructure, lifecycle, critical data, native acceptance and rollback gates are incomplete.

confidence.basis: Current release plan explicitly says NO-GO.

entities.title: Critical data progression gate is missing
entities.definition: The product lacks the complete scheduled proof that every required producer observed upstream, reached a terminal result and was consumed by the exact static candidate.

confidence.basis: Release plan marks it release-blocking and missing.

entities.title: User and owner outcome evidence is incomplete
entities.definition: The product has extensive requirements, UI, implementation and runtime evidence, but unified production task-completion, cards-to-value, retention and causal outcome evidence is not yet available.

confidence.basis: Analytics current boundary and Product Atlas facet audit.

entities.title: Event lifecycle can produce stale public artifacts
entities.definition: Mutable canonical event date/status and immutable publication snapshots can diverge, causing a stale or wrong public message unless guarded and reconciled.
unresolved_conflicts: Incident repair is accepted; long-term recurrence evidence is not.

entities.title: UI families and archetypes remain reconstructed candidates
entities.definition: The corrected semantic SoT provides 17 stable reconstructed archetypes and route coverage, but promoted component families/archetypes and full Astro–SoT–Penpot parity are not complete.

confidence.basis: Design-system checklist and corrected SoT lifecycle.

unresolved_conflicts: Product linkage can use stable semantic IDs before UI promotion, but Penpot bindings must remain pending.

entities.title: Product Atlas plugin documentation is stale
entities.definition: Historical documents, contracts and prototypes still describe a Product Atlas Penpot plugin even though the accepted delivery path is explicit Penpot MCP materialization from Git SoT.

confidence.basis: Current owner correction and repository audit.

unresolved_conflicts: Design-system companion PR must remove active plugin artifacts and references.

entities.title: Partner needs are unresearched
entities.definition: The product has partner-facing pages and operator processes but no dedicated evidence sufficient to define partner needs, Jobs or outcomes.
unresolved_conflicts: Dedicated partner research is required before modeling.

entities.title: EventCard family is not promoted
entities.definition: Card census and candidate work exist, but no owner-accepted promoted EventCard/medallion package has completed full evidence, read-back and consumer migration.
unresolved_conflicts: Product semantics are linked to source identities without treating candidate UI as promoted.

entities.title: Event Detail has unresolved UI states
entities.definition: The corrected Event Detail archetype is source-proven but some requested desktop/mobile layout and no-image states lack exact source/browser evidence and remain non-materialization-eligible.
unresolved_conflicts: Unresolved states must not receive fabricated Penpot bindings.

entities.title: Search, Favorites and Personal Feed are not normalized/promoted
entities.definition: Production/prototype routes and state logic exist, but shared identity, loading/error/recovery patterns and promoted archetype/component bindings remain incomplete.
unresolved_conflicts: Search runtime health is accepted even though its design-system normalization remains open.

entities.title: Loading, empty, error, retry, stale and undo states lack one accepted vocabulary
entities.definition: Concrete Search, Favorites, feedback and media states exist, but ownership, geometry and cross-page semantics are not yet normalized from the factual skeleton/loading archive.

confidence.basis: Design-system planning explicitly leaves the vocabulary open.

unresolved_conflicts: Skeleton archive ingestion is required before redesign; absence does not block Git Product Atlas linkage.

entities.title: Shell and foundation roles are not fully accepted/promoted
entities.definition: Typography, colors, spacing, radii, container/grid, header, mobile menu, bottom navigation, overlays and footer have candidates but not one site-wide owner-accepted promoted package.
unresolved_conflicts: Foundation audit and owner synthesis are scheduled after AS-IS parity, not automatically accepted from one candidate.

entities.title: Product Atlas Penpot bindings are pending
entities.definition: Stable product and corrected UI semantic identities exist, but actual Product Atlas Penpot file/page/shape bindings have not been read or materialized because MCP is intentionally not connected in this Git-only task.
unresolved_conflicts: Every binding remains typed `binding_pending`; no UUID is present.

entities.title: The old Product Atlas pilot is an incomplete hypothesis, not the complete model
entities.definition: Repository evidence shows one root discovery Job, two journeys and six capabilities were intentionally scoped as a pilot; current product requirements prove additional Jobs, journeys, outcomes, recovery paths and operator capabilities.

confidence.basis: Historical architecture/pilot artifacts and current feature corpus.

entities.title: UI, code and release evidence do not prove user or owner outcomes
entities.definition: The corpus contains extensive implemented routes, acceptance tests and runtime receipts, while North Star, task completion, retention and causal uplift remain only partially measured; facets must remain independent.

confidence.basis: Product methodology and analytics current boundary.

entities.title: Product meaning belongs to route/archetype region/state context, not one generic component master
entities.definition: The corrected UI SoT reuses visual component candidates across materially different route contexts; Job/outcome linkage is often accurate only at configured instance, pattern, semantic region or ProductScreenState level.

confidence.basis: Corrected route/archetype/region contracts and operating-model boundary.

entities.title: Product Atlas plugin delivery is superseded by explicit MCP materialization
entities.definition: Historical plugin docs/contracts/prototypes are real implementation evidence but conflict with the current owner decision to use Penpot MCP for later scoped materialization; they must be removed from active documentation and preserved only in Git history/source ledger.

confidence.basis: Explicit owner correction plus repository evidence.

unresolved_conflicts: Companion design-system PR must complete deletion/update of active plugin references.

entities.title: Search runtime is healthy while user satisfaction remains only partially evidenced
entities.definition: Four accepted platform health cells prove current target, one physical POST, card parity, real scroll and event open, but they do not establish matched-rate or query-quality outcomes across the intent distribution.

confidence.basis: Accepted Search health and analytics distinction.

unresolved_conflicts: Search feedback and broader quality aggregates remain partial.

entities.title: Current event truth requires runtime and incident evidence, not only build contracts
entities.definition: The stale Telegram repost incident occurred despite substantial lifecycle and publication contracts; current-truth capability must combine static parity, authoritative state, immutable snapshots, runtime guards and incident evidence.
unresolved_conflicts: Long-term recurrence evidence is not yet available.

entities.title: `events-bot-new` is the canonical owner of product meaning
entities.definition: Needs, Jobs, outcomes, journeys, capabilities, stories, evidence questions, findings and decisions live in `events-bot-new`; other repositories reference these IDs only.

decision_contract.follow_up: Maintain the canonical registry and validate foreign-key projections.

entities.title: Design-system stores product foreign keys and exact UI context only
entities.definition: `lovekgd-design-system` owns UI semantics and conformance and must not become a second source for Job, outcome, capability, measurement, finding or decision definitions.

decision_contract.follow_up: Publish a thin UI-linkage projection on a child branch of corrected UI SoT.

entities.title: Product Atlas Penpot materialization uses MCP, not a Product Atlas plugin
entities.definition: The active future path is explicit scoped Penpot MCP materialization from reviewed versioned Git SoT in a separate Product Atlas file; plugin manifests, contracts, prototype bundles and background sync are obsolete.

decision_contract.follow_up: Remove active plugin artifacts/documentation; keep actual Penpot bindings pending until an explicit MCP pass.

unresolved_conflicts: Penpot is intentionally not connected in this Git-only task.

entities.title: Future partner needs, Jobs and outcomes remain `not_modeled`
entities.definition: Partner meaning is not inferred from partner pages, venues or operator workflows; a dedicated research and owner-decision pass is required.

decision_contract.follow_up: Commission dedicated partner research before creating partner entities.

unresolved_conflicts: Partner research has not been performed.

entities.title: Definition, delivery, verification, deployment, runtime and outcomes remain independent facets
entities.definition: No entity receives one `done` state; UI/code/release/runtime evidence and user/owner outcomes can differ and must be reported separately.

decision_contract.follow_up: Validate every Product Atlas entity against the facet schema.

entities.title: Unknown Penpot bindings use `binding_pending`
entities.definition: No file/page/shape UUID is inferred or copied from non-public local state; until an explicit MCP read-back exists, links retain null IDs and a typed pending reason.

decision_contract.follow_up: Resolve bindings only during a later explicit Penpot MCP materialization/read-back.

unresolved_conflicts: No Penpot MCP call was made in this task.

entities.title: Route-specific product context is preserved
entities.definition: Product/UI links may reuse an archetype or component identity but keep exact route, semantic region, state, viewport, configured instance, acceptance and measurement context; distinct contexts are not collapsed by visual similarity.

confidence.basis: Corrected UI SoT and product linkage finding.

decision_contract.follow_up: Validate all UI link rows preserve context/state/viewport and route identity.

entities.title: Product Atlas consumes reviewed versioned evidence only
entities.definition: Raw analytics, production DB rows, screenshots without provenance and automatic hotspot interpretations cannot create Product Atlas findings or decisions; product-specific reviewed records remain in `events-bot-new`.

supersedes: direct raw analytics input to Product Atlas
decision_contract.follow_up: Publish immutable evidence packages linked to questions/findings/decisions.

unresolved_conflicts: Many reviewed outcome packages do not yet exist.

entities.title: User Story is not the center of the product model
entities.definition: Stable Jobs, outcomes, journeys, capabilities and domain events anchor product meaning; User Stories remain replaceable vertical delivery slices and technical work retains honest non-user kinds.

decision_contract.follow_up: Validate each User Story as a vertical slice and classify pages/APIs/migrations as UI/enabler/operator/release work.
